experiment.topic: Gap-down quality in BTC-USD: 30-hour mean reversion probability after 2% gap-down events
experiment.hypothesis: After a 2% gap-down event in BTC-USD, price reverts to its mean within 30 hours with a probability exceeding 5% in a 5-hour return distribution, indicating a statistically significant mean reversion.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: For at least 100 hourly gap-down events in BTC-USD exceeding 2% with a 5-hour return less than 2%, the 30-hour mean reversion probability must be statistically significant (p < 0.05) when tested against a null hypothesis of no reversion using a t-test on the distribution of 5-hour returns.
